# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(UCell)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/sc_combined_subclusters.RData")
```



# Subset scRNAseq for C26 tumour-bearing muscle

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(all_genes, Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined)

Idents(sc_combined) <- "experiment"

C26_model <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Pryce_scC26")

rm(sc_combined)
```



# Read in the list of receptors that match ligands from bulkRNAseq of C26 tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_receptors <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/C26_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", header = FALSE)

C26_receptors <- C26_receptors[[1]]
```



# Check to see which genes are not present in C26_model and remove from C26_receptors

```{r}
C26_receptors_use <- intersect(C26_receptors, rownames(C26_model))

not_in_model <- setdiff(C26_receptors, rownames(C26_model))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, C26_receptors)
```



# Get DEGs

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(C26_model) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_C26_model <- FindMarkers(C26_model, ident.1 = "Pryce_scC26_C26", ident.2 = "Pryce_scC26_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```

### Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05 and avg_log2FC > 0.2 and in C26_receptors_use

```{r}
DEGs_C26_model <- subset(DEGs_C26_model, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.2)

DEGs_C26_model <- DEGs_C26_model[rownames(DEGs_C26_model) %in% C26_receptors_use,
]

rownames(DEGs_C26_model)
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(DEGs_C26_model, DEGs_C26_model_IDs, DEGs_C26_model_gene_names)
```



# Score cells for receptor expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_receptors_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(C26_model, features = list(C26_receptors_use), name = "C26_receptors_score")

means_C26_receptors_score <- C26_receptors_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_C26_receptors_score = mean(signature_1C26_receptors_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_C26_receptors_score)
```

```{r}
cluster_colours <- c(
    "Satellite cells"      = "#FF7FBF",
    "Myoblasts"            = "#FF3F80",
    "Myonuclei"            = "#E00000",
    "Endothelial cells"    = "#FFFF00",
    "vSMCs"                = "#BC9D00",
    "Pericytes"            = "#8B5A2B",
    "FAPs"                 = "#7CFC00",
    "Tenocytes"            = "#228B22",
    "Platelets"            = "#D46A6A", 
    "Mast cells"           = "#C85C8C", 
    "Dendritic cells"      = "#B84D9E", 
    "Monocytes"            = "#80E5FF",
    "Macrophages"          = "#1E90FF",
    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
    "B cells"              = "#C9A2FF",
    "T cells"              = "#B44CFF",
    "NK cells"             = "#5B0E8A",
    "Neural/glial cells"   = "#FF7F00",
    "Schwann cells"        = "#FFA64D" 
)

VlnPlot(C26_receptors_score, features = "signature_1C26_receptors_score", group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "C26 receptors score", title = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black")
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(
  C26_receptors_score, features = "signature_1C26_receptors_score", reduction = "umap") +
  labs(color = "C26 receptors score") +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())
```

## Remove unused objects


# Read in MC38 tumour (scRNAseq)

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/MC38_tumours_immune_scRNAseq.RData")

MC38_tumour <- MC38_tumour_singlets
rm(MC38_tumour_singlets)
```


## Read in the list of ligands from bulkRNAseq of C26 tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_ligands <- read.csv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/tumour_bulk_RNAseq/receptor_lists/C26_secreted_genes.csv", header = FALSE)

C26_ligands <- C26_ligands[[1]]
```


## Check to see which genes are not present in MC38_tumour and remove from C26_ligands

```{r}
C26_ligands_use <- intersect(C26_ligands, rownames(MC38_tumour))

not_in_model <- setdiff(C26_ligands, rownames(MC38_tumour))

not_in_model

rm(not_in_model, C26_ligands)
```


## Score cells for ligand expression

```{r, include=FALSE}
C26_ligands_score <- AddModuleScore_UCell(MC38_tumour, features = list(C26_ligands_use), name = "C26_ligands_score")

means_C26_ligands_score <- C26_ligands_score@meta.data %>%
  group_by(seurat_clusters) %>%
  summarise(average_C26_ligands_score = mean(signature_1C26_ligands_score, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
print(means_C26_ligands_score)
```


```{r}
MC38_tumour_cluster_colours <- c(

    "Neutrophils"          = "#4169E1",
```
